arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'pending_bookings' AS kind, json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'step',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.booking_id=b.booking_id))) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status<>'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'events',json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status<>'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancellations',json_group_array(json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'flights',json_group_array(json_object('id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache

SELECT 'events' AS kind,json_group_array(json_object('event_id',o.event_id,'booking_id',o.booking_id,'payload',o.payload,'attempts',o.attempts,'booking_status',b.status,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id)) AS data FROM outbox o LEFT JOIN bookings b ON b.booking_id=o.booking_id WHERE o.status='pending' UNION ALL SELECT 'cancellations',json_group_array(json_object('request_id',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_group_array(json_object('service',service,'value',value)) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_holds',json_group_array(json_object('flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step)) FROM fare_holds

SELECT b.*,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.amount_cents AS charge_amount,c.state AS charge_state,c.created_step,e.event_id AS cancellation,e.step AS cancellation_step FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c ON c.booking_id=b.booking_id LEFT JOIN customer_events e ON e.request_id=b.request_id WHERE b.status<>'confirmed' ORDER BY b.client_reference,b.booking_id
